name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PointInsert.no_first_level_cover
title: No cover with an all-ones tail after level 0 exists when some prefix through the first bit b is not allowed
statement: If every pad is alive only on allowed prefixes, every fully falsifying prefix is allowed, and some prefix of length at least 1 starting with bit b is not allowed, then no pad and no clause has entry 1 at (0, b) and only 1-entries after level 0.
